Total marks are 100 of which 90 marks will be allotted basing on the marks obtained in qualifying examination and 10 marks will be awarded for the age. Weight-age for age will be reckoned from 18 years of age of the candidate. 0.5 mark will be awarded for one completed year of age with a maximum of 10 marks. followed by objection submission and final selection list as per rules of reservation and presidential orders.
how_to_apply: Download the application form and instructions from the official website at https://rajannasircilla.telangana.gov.in.
Fill out the application form with all required personal and educational details.
Obtain a Demand Draft for Rs. 500/- (for Other Caste) or Rs. 300/- (for SC, ST, and PH) in favor of "the District Medical and Health Officer, Rajanna Sircilla".
Enclose self-attested copies of all required certificates, mark memos, registration certificates, caste certificate, study certificates, and the original DD.
Submit the filled application form either in person or through registered post to the Office of the District Medical and Health Officer, Rajanna Sircilla, IDOC, Rajanna Sircilla District.
Ensure the application reaches on or before 30 October 2026 by 5:00 PM. Applications received after the due date will be summarily rejected.
important_instructions: Applications received after due date will be summarily rejected and the District Selection Committee is not responsible for postal delays. Rule of Reservation shall be followed as per Government Orders from time to time. Presidential Orders 2018 is to be followed, and the post of Lab Technician is as Zonal Posts. Vacancies for posts mentioned in G.O.68 falling in Scheduled Areas should be filled exclusively with Local Scheduled Tribes. Since Health and Wellness Centres located in Municipal areas are to be filled up by only MBBS/BAMS Doctors, they will be permitted to opt for either urban or rural Health Wellness Centres or both. Candidates must regularly follow the district official website to know the latest developments, merit lists, and certificate verification dates.

content_sections.heading: About DMHO Rajanna Sircilla Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: This recruitment drive is conducted by the District Selection Committee, Rajanna Sircilla under the National Health Mission (NHM) and various state health programmes. The appointments are made to fill vacant positions across primary health care units, urban health missions, NCD clinics, and district early intervention centres on a contract and outsourcing basis to strengthen public healthcare services in Rajanna Sircilla.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DMHO Rajanna Sircilla Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form and instructions from the official website at https://rajannasircilla.telangana.gov.in. Fill out the application form with all required personal and educational details. Obtain a Demand Draft for Rs. 500/- (for Other Caste) or Rs. 300/- (for SC, ST, and PH) in favor of "the District Medical and Health Officer, Rajanna Sircilla". Enclose self-attested copies of all required certificates, mark memos, registration certificates, caste certificate, study certificates, and the original DD. Submit the filled application form either in person or through registered post to the Office of the District Medical and Health Officer, Rajanna Sircilla, IDOC, Rajanna Sircilla District. Ensure the application reaches on or before 30 October 2026 by 5:00 PM. Applications received after the due date will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DMHO Rajanna Sircilla Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit filled applications is 30 October 2026 by 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 33 vacancies are notified across various health programmes and posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for OC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for Other Caste (OC) candidates is Rs. 500/-, payable via Demand Draft.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 44 years as on 01.07.2026, with relaxations for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection criteria for DMHO Rajanna Sircilla posts?
faq.answer: Selection is based on merit, taking 90% weightage from marks obtained in the qualifying examination and 10% weightage for age (0.5 mark per year up to a maximum of 10 marks).

faq.question: Q6. Where should the application form be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted in person or sent through registered post to the District Medical and Health Officer, Rajanna Sircilla, IDOC, Rajanna Sircilla District.

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualification required for Staff Nurse posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess B.Sc. Nursing or GNM and be registered with the TS Nursing Council.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any provision for age relaxation for SC and ST candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, a relaxation of 5 years is applicable for S.C's, S.T's, and BC's.
